programmes.t: On the Case: Betrayal in the Mountains
programmes.d: A man calls 911, saying his wife had been shot when she walked in on a robbery, and that he had used deadly force on the intruder. The investigation of what seems like an open-and-shut case of self defense reveals the secrets of several past murders.

programmes.t: On the Case: Mystery, Heartbreak and Justice
programmes.d: A look at three cases in which the quest for justice rages on after the verdict has been delivered.

programmes.t: On the Case: Crossed by Evil
programmes.d: Police race to find a young woman who disappeared on her way to work, but the clues they discover reveal a trail of unspeakable evil.

programmes.t: On the Case: From Dusk to Darkness
programmes.d: After a 10-year-old girl mysteriously disappears, her family and the police undergo a tormenting journey to find a lead.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Nightmare in Laurel
programmes.d: When a young woman disappears before her final shift at a Maryland hospital, her family begins a decades-long search for answers.

programmes.t: On the Case: Evil Repeats Itself
programmes.d: Beautiful teenager Mary Jayne Jones is found murdered in a desolate farmhouse while its owner is out of town.

programmes.t: On the Case: Terror in Terre Haute
programmes.d: When a young college student is abducted from her campus parking lot it marks the beginning of a terrifying crime wave on a quiet college campus. Can police catch a serial predator before he strikes again?

programmes.t: On the Case: A Heartbreaking Discovery
programmes.d: When a young mother disappears police painstakingly retrace her last known movements. The trail of clues they uncover leads to a shocking and heartbreaking discovery.

programmes.t: On the Case: Same Crime Next Year
programmes.d: A teenager is found murdered on the weekend of the Daytona 500 motor race in Daytona Beach, Florida. Then, one year later, police are called to the scene of a nearly identical crime.

programmes.t: On the Case: Half Way Home
programmes.d: The discovery of a woman's body inside an abandoned trailer leads to a 28-year search for the person responsible for her beating death.

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Hymn
programmes.d: March 29th 1981. It was a warm Sunday afternoon in Mishawaka, Indiana when the mother of 28-year-old Gerry Gherardi received a disturbing call from the local priest. He informed her that Gerry, the church's organist did not show up to morning services.

programmes.t: On the Case: Circled by Vultures
programmes.d: A tourist takes a photo of vultures in Joshua Tree National Park and inadvertently discovers a gruesome homicide.

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder in Store
programmes.d: In San Antonio, Texas, video game store manager Amber Belken is murdered in an apparent robbery gone wrong. On further investigation, however, detectives are troubled by the evidence.

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Riddle
programmes.d: Nine days after 11-year-old Mary Stiles goes missing while trick-or-treating, a letter arrives at the police station leading investigators to Stiles' body; then, investigators must decipher a series of riddles before the killer strikes again.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Cracked Alibi
programmes.d: If investigators can't find the crack in their suspect's seemingly air-tight alibi, a cold-blooded killer will elude justice.

programmes.t: On the Case: Stabbed in the Heart
programmes.d: A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom. A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.

programmes.t: On the Case: Betrayal and Regret
programmes.d: After a teenage girl is found murdered in an isolated cemetery, police must untangle a dark mystery in order to bring her killer to justice.

programmes.t: On the Case: Tracks of a Killer
programmes.d: Police retrace a young woman's final movements with hope that it will lead them straight to her killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 2
programmes.d: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On the Case.

programmes.t: On the Case: Officer Down
programmes.d: A detective moonlighting at an Atlanta hotel is fatally wounded in a furious gun battle with two robbers. The case goes cold for more than 25 years, until an unusual call comes in from an unlikely informant.

programmes.t: On the Case: Fatal Turn
programmes.d: A devoted mother vanishes on her way home from work. Her disappearance sends police into the darkest corners of the state and our justice system.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Deadly Secret
programmes.d: A small town hair dresser is found beaten and strangled in her beauty salon. After the investigation goes cold, an act of conscience cracks the case.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Long Journey To Justice
programmes.d: When a young college student is found murdered on the side of road, it is the start of a tormenting 26 year journey to justice for her family.

programmes.t: On the Case: Profile of a Killer
programmes.d: When a beautiful young woman is found murdered in the basement of her brand new home, Police are forced to use cutting edge techniques to solve a terrifying mystery.

programmes.t: On the Case: This is for Her
programmes.d: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programmes.t: On the Case: A Blue Raincoat
programmes.d: After a young girl disappears on her way home from school, police find her blue raincoat thirty miles away. It marks the beginning of a heartbreaking homicide investigation.

programmes.t: On the Case: As She Lay Dying
programmes.d: August 19th, 2014. It was a hot afternoon in Portland, Oregon when police received a distressing 911-call. A woman had been stabbed at an apartment complex. By the time first responders arrived, the victim had already lost too much blood to be saved.

programmes.t: On the Case: River of Sorrow
programmes.d: Wednesday, June 1, 2011, police in Platte City, Missouri received an unusual call. A man on his lunch break was walking in a secluded area along the Platte River when he stumbled upon what appeared to be a body submerged in the murky water.
